topic: Campaign data requirements and API scope
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on recalling specific data requests from the finance team. It was confirmed that demographic data had been re-imported from Rainbow. Regarding metrics, no new metrics were requested; instead, the request involved expanding the API functionality and accelerating campaign reporting. The scope of the required API parameters was discussed, noting that while 'hours' were mentioned as an example, the general requirement seemed to encompass all campaign parameters.
decisions: The API needs expansion to cover comprehensive campaign parameters.
action_items: Describe all necessary campaign parameters for the API expansion.
